title: Cultivation Protocol for Anaerobic Ciliates
author: Johana Rotterova
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.85why7e

steps.title: Collect environmental sample
steps.instruction: Isolate 10 ml of the targeted sample (e.g., freshwater sulphidic sediment) from the environment of interest.

steps.title: Select appropriate ATCC medium
steps.instruction: Choose ATCC #802 (Sonneborn's Paramecium medium) for freshwater ciliates or ATCC #1525 (Seawater Sonneborn's Paramecium medium) for marine ciliates; the preparation details follow.

steps.title: Prepare freshwater ATCC #802 media
steps.instruction: Prepare 500 ml of ATCC #802 Freshwater Cereal Grass medium as follows:

substeps.instruction: Measure 500 ml distilled water (dH₂O) into a flask.
Add 1.25 g cerophylle and boil for 5 min.
Filter the hot solution through filter paper.
Add an additional 100 ml distilled water to compensate for evaporation.
Filter the cooled solution through Whatman #1 filter paper.

steps.title: Prepare seawater ATCC #1525 media
steps.instruction: Prepare 1 L of ATCC #1525 Seawater Cereal Grass medium as follows:

substeps.instruction: Cereal Grass component: dissolve 2.5 g cerophylle in 500 ml dH₂O, boil 5 min, filter (no Na₂HPO₄).
Artificial seawater component A (SWA): dissolve 24.72 g NaCl, 0.67 g KCl, 1.36 g CaCl₂·2H₂O, and 4.66 g MgCl₂·6H₂O in 300 ml dH₂O.
Artificial seawater component B (SWB): dissolve 6.29 g MgSO₄·7H₂O in 100 ml dH₂O.
Artificial seawater component C (SWC): dissolve 0.18 g NaHCO₃ in 100 ml dH₂O.
After cooling, combine the cereal grass solution with the three seawater components.

steps.title: Inoculate sediment into media
steps.instruction: Add 1 ml of the collected sediment to a 15 ml Falcon tube containing 10 ml of the prepared medium; repeat this addition four times (total 4 ml sediment per tube).

steps.title: Re‑inoculate cultures biweekly
steps.instruction: Every two weeks, transfer 1 ml of each sedimented culture into a fresh 15 ml Falcon tube with 10 ml of the designated medium.
